overall_reason: The header marks 'Home' as the current page with a dot and weight, the phone header swaps the six links for an 'Open navigation' button, the hero's /polish, /distill and /clarify tabs mark their selection, and the install steps are a numbered disclosure list with a copy button and a 'Next' link per step.

score.reason: T-WHERE-AM-I, T-PHONE-NAV, T-PRIMARY-COUNT and T-INTERRUPT pass, and the stylesheet declares every state family; T-ONE-FAMILY finds near-miss radii in the page's own controls, and T-OVERLAY-CHECK and T-ERROR-PATH could not run because the capture's clicks navigated the page (CMP-005).

visitor_mode: Persuade (inferred: a landing page for an agent design skill with one primary action, 'Install Impeccable'; the page also holds labelled exhibits such as a before-and-after card, a hotel demo site and a command console)

findings.title: Controls belong to one family
findings.where: page chrome buttons outside the exhibits, 1440, tiles/1440-00.png, 1440-03.png, 1440-07.png
findings.evidence: The components table lists 26 button variants. Among the page's own controls (not the hotel demo or the console exhibit), 'Install Impeccable' and 'Follow on X' use a 3 px radius at 44 px, the intent buttons ('Make text easier to read', 'Simplify a busy page') a 5 px radius at 40 px, the command keys ('init', 'polish') a 6 px radius at 44 px, and the 'TRY NEXT' chips ('layout', 'polish') a 4 px radius at 22 px.
findings.before: Four radii (3, 4, 5 and 6 px) and heights from 22 to 44 px on controls of the same flat style.
findings.after: One radius for rectangular controls (4 px) and two heights (32 px for chips and keys, 44 px for actions).
findings.why: Radii that differ by a pixel or two read as drift rather than as a choice.

strengths: The header marks 'Home' as the current page with a teal dot and a heavier weight (tiles/1440-00.png y 38).
At 375 the six header links move behind a named 'Open navigation' button (36 by 36 px) in a sticky header.
One filled primary on the first screen, 'Install Impeccable', with 'How it works' as a text link; the label matches the install section's heading.

The install section is a numbered step list ('1 Install Impeccable', '2 Initialize & enable hooks') with install-method tabs (CLI selected), a copy button on the command and a 'Next: set up your project' link.
The stylesheet declares hover (172), focus-visible (49), active (11), disabled (9), selected (54), expanded (28) and busy (20) rules, and the focus walk starts on 'Skip to content'.

The DOM holds designed states for its demo components: an empty state ('No teammates yet'), an error with a recovery line ('We couldn't send that invite. Check the address and try again'), 'Step 1 of 3' and 'Sent'.
